standardReference: Apple App Store Connect Accessibility Nutrition Labels (9 Core Categories)

labels.description: Screen reader navigation across core workout, login, and settings flows.
codebaseEvidence: Semantic HTML landmarks, native <button>/<input>/<label> controls, and descriptive aria-label attributes across AccountLoginModal, AccessibilitySettingsPanel, DataMigrationPanel, and AccessibleVideoPlayer.
Live status announcements using role='status', role='alert', and aria-live='polite' for Force Pull, JSON Backup import, Magic Link OTP, and set completion.

labels.description: Hands-free voice command targeting of interactive buttons and form inputs.
codebaseEvidence: Visible button text aligns directly with accessible names (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name) such as 'Send Magic Link', 'Force Pull from Cloud', 'Export JSON Backup', and 'Play Slow-Mo'.
All interactive targets are >= 44x44px to 48x48px native controls with clear single-tap alternatives to drag gestures.

labels.description: Scales text cleanly to 200%+ without clipping or horizontal overflow (Web Dynamic Type equivalent).
codebaseEvidence: 100% relative rem typography tokens in src/styles/accessibility.css and Tailwind components.
Flexible flex-wrap and responsive grid reflow tested at 390x844 mobile viewport plus Dyslexia-friendly spacing presets.

labels.description: First-class high-contrast Dark Mode respecting OS preference and manual override.
codebaseEvidence: AccessibilityThemeProvider & src/utils/themeProvider.ts provide Dark (#1A1A1A / #F2F2F2), Light (#F7F7F7 / #0A1128), and System themes persisted to localStorage.

labels.description: Never relies solely on color to communicate status, progress, or errors.
codebaseEvidence: Completed sets, toggle states ('ON'/'OFF'), Adherence-Neutral 30-day consistency scores, Visual Plate Loader weights, and form alerts pair high-contrast text labels and icons with color.
Sensory-Calm Mode reduces color saturation under 5% while keeping every state legible.

labels.description: Meets or exceeds WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios (>= 4.5:1 text, >= 3:1 UI borders/icons).
codebaseEvidence: Automated contrast verification via calculateWcagContrastRatio in unit tests.
High-contrast Light and Dark theme tokens plus high-contrast black-backed WebVTT caption overlays in AccessibleVideoPlayer.

labels.description: Minimizes or removes UI motion, animations, and sudden layout jumps.
codebaseEvidence: Global Sensory-Calm Mode and prefers-reduced-motion CSS rules disable transitions/animations and lock layout stability.
withStableViewportScroll prevents vertical scroll jumping during set logging; AccessibleVideoPlayer defaults to calm 0.5x slow-motion playback.

labels.description: Synchronized closed captions enabled by default on exercise demonstration videos.
codebaseEvidence: AccessibleVideoPlayer parses and displays synchronized WebVTT (.vtt) closed captions by default (captionsEnabled: true) with both visual overlay and native <track kind='captions'> plus full text transcript.

labels.description: Spoken audio-description tracks for prerecorded exercise videos.
codebaseEvidence: Current Phase 1 provides synchronized Grade 6-8 literal text steps, posterAlt descriptions, and full text scripts for muted-by-default playback.
Dedicated spoken WebVTT/audio-description voice tracks are scheduled for Phase 2 native iOS/App Store submission before checking this label in App Store Connect.
